description: In an Uno app project, SessionStart (also after a compaction) tells the agent that a running app is edited through Hot Reload, not rebuilt, and to look for a running app before the first build; elsewhere it prints nothing. After a .xaml or .cs edit, PostToolUse asks the DevServer (uno-devserver app hot-reload-status) whether the running Uno app applied it through Hot Reload. The App MCP that the Uno.Sdk 6.7 service release after 6.7.30 pins (1.4) has no status tool, so on this line the CLI never reports a verdict and the hook says nothing; without the CLI or a solution file above the edited file, it reminds the agent that Hot Reload applies the edit and that a check by selector, or uno_app_start again, confirms it.
